keys.doc: PipeWire node name to capture from (see `dettivo doctor` or audio.devices). Empty follows the default source, including when the default changes.
How often a level sample (RMS and peak) is published, in milliseconds.
A meeting's system track: "default_monitor" captures the default sink's monitor and follows the default when it changes; a sink's node name pins that sink's monitor.
Lowest level written to the journal: error, warn, info, debug, trace. No level ever logs transcript text, audio or prompts.
How long a graceful shutdown may take before the process exits anyway.
Language code (en, de, ...) or auto.
The longest take in seconds before the session stops itself.

raw (the engine's text with the raw pipeline), deterministic_polish (the Polish pass, no model; "polish" is the contract's alias) or enhanced (Polish, then a language model rewrite through [llm]; falls back to Polish with a notice when no provider answers in time).

File names, paths, URLs, email addresses, versions and dotted identifiers (index.ts, src/app, example.com, v1.2.3, foo.bar) pass through untouched: no sentence end on a dot inside one, no replacement inside one.
Whole-word replacements applied after recognition, case-insensitive: replacements = { teh = "the", dettivo = "Dettivo" }
A take whose peak level stays under this is treated as silence.
Spoken punctuation ("comma", "period", "new line") becomes marks.
Words the engine is primed with: names, products, jargon.

Compute backend: auto (CUDA when its provider and runtime load, else CPU with the reason), cpu, cuda (CUDA or a failed load). DETTIVO_FORCE_CPU=1 overrides this choice. The CUDA drop-in needs CUDA 13 and cuDNN 9.
Threads the diarization engine runs its models on; 0 is the core count capped at four.
Directory searched for engine binaries (dettivo-engine-whisper, ...) before PATH. Empty means the daemon's own directory and PATH.
The same for the language model engine; auto falls back to the CPU with the reason when the model does not fit the device's free memory.
The context length in tokens the model is loaded with.
The most tokens one Enhanced rewrite may generate.
The same for the language model engine (dettivo-engine-llm).
The same for the Parakeet engine.
Seconds a speech engine stays warm after its last request before it is unloaded and its process ends, returning GPU memory.

Compute backend for the Whisper engine: auto (Vulkan when a device is installed and the model loads there, else CPU), vulkan (Vulkan or a failed load), cpu. DETTIVO_FORCE_CPU=1 overrides both engines.
What lives beside the database and what a delete removes: "keep" (audio and metadata.json), "audio_only" (no sidecar), or "none" (rows only).
Days after which retained audio is removed by the hourly sweep; 0 keeps it.
The SQLite database. Empty means <data_dir>/dettivo.db.
Keep the take of every finished dictation beside its item, under <data_dir>/dictations/<id>/, so it can be re-run with another model.
The longest audio file an import accepts, in seconds; a longer one is refused after the probe, before anything is decoded.
Items kept; the oldest beyond this are removed by the sweep. 0 keeps all.

The daemon-side hotkey backend: auto, portal, evdev or none. Compositor bindings written by `dettivo setup` call the CLI and need no backend; auto uses the portal's GlobalShortcuts (GNOME, KDE) when it answers.
Drop the session.
Input devices for the evdev backend (/dev/input/event*); empty means every keyboard. Reading them needs the `input` group.
Chords in Hyprland notation: modifiers (SUPER, CTRL, ALT, SHIFT), a comma, the key. Omarchy's Voxtype keys are the defaults. Hold to talk: press starts, release stops.
Pause playing MPRIS players while capturing and resume them after.
Insert the last transcript again.
Play a short sound on start, stop and error (never during a meeting).
One press starts, the next stops.

"auto" tries, in order, the Wayland virtual keyboard, libei through the RemoteDesktop portal, ydotool, xdotool, clipboard plus a paste keystroke, then clipboard only. A backend name pins it; an unavailable pin fails with its reason instead of falling back.
How long the restore waits for the target to take the paste, in milliseconds. A clipboard the user changed meanwhile is left alone.
Pause between typed keys, in milliseconds.
Paste keystroke per app id for the clipboard path (`ctrl+v`, `ctrl+shift+v`, `shift+insert`). Terminals default to ctrl+shift+v, everything else to ctrl+v.
Put the previous clipboard back after a clipboard insertion.
App ids of Dettivo's own windows. Insertion into one of them fails with target_is_self and never pastes.
App ids that are terminals and take ctrl+shift+v.
How long after an insertion `dettivo insert undo` may take it back.

"peer": any process of the same user may connect (SO_PEERCRED). "peer_token": the same, plus the shared token from DETTIVO_IPC_TOKEN, the Secret Service item (service "dettivo", key "ipc-token") or token_file.
Longest request line the daemon accepts, in bytes. A longer line is answered with INVALID_PARAMS and the connection stays open.
Socket path. Empty means $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dettivo/dettivo.sock; the systemd socket unit and DETTIVO_IPC_SOCKET override it.
Token file for peer_token mode, must be mode 0600. Empty means $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dettivo/ipc.token.
The model meeting analysis loads; empty means `model`.
A file (mode 0600) holding the endpoint's API key; the Secret Service item (service "dettivo", key "llm-api-key") is read first.
The model the endpoint is asked for.
An OpenAI-compatible base URL; /v1/chat/completions is appended. A host other than localhost is used only after `dettivo llm trust <url>`.
Where sideloaded fine-tunes and their manifests live. Empty means <models_dir>/polish-experiments.
Repair attempts after a rejected rewrite, within the same budget.
The catalogue model the local engine loads for Enhanced: qwen3-4b-instruct-2507 (default), qwen3-1.7b (fast), qwen3-4b (quality), qwen3-8b. `dettivo llm download --model <id>` fetches it.
The Ollama model (`ollama pull qwen3:4b-instruct`).
Where Ollama answers; auto detects it through GET /api/tags.

A sideloaded polish fine-tune Enhanced runs on instead of `model`: the name of a manifest under experiments_dir ("current" reads current.json, the macOS manifest shape). Empty keeps the catalogue model; `dettivo llm experiment use` sets it and `dettivo llm experiment status` shows it.
The provider behind Enhanced: auto (the first available of local, ollama, openai_compatible), local (dettivo-engine-llm with a catalogue model), ollama or openai_compatible.
The whole Enhanced pass must finish within this; then the Polish text is inserted and the notice says provider_unavailable.
Remote endpoints you confirmed; `dettivo llm trust` appends here.
`dettivo mcp config` adds the DETTIVO_IPC_TOKEN placeholder to every host entry, as `--hardened` does; pair it with [ipc] auth_mode = "peer_token".
Longest MCP message accepted or produced over stdio, in bytes (the macOS bound). A longer message is refused naming the cap; the session continues.
Analyse every meeting once it finalises (a summary, the decisions, the action items) through the language model provider; off leaves it to `dettivo meetings analyze <id>`.
Characters of transcript per model call; a longer transcript is analysed in parts and the parts are merged in one final call.
The provider the analysis asks: local, ollama, openai_compatible or auto; empty follows [llm] provider. [llm] analysis_model names the local model.
The whole analysis must finish within this; then it is failed with provider_unavailable and can be run again.

What lives in the meeting directory once the meeting stopped: "keep" (audio, journal.jsonl, the take sidecars and metadata.json), "audio_only" (no metadata.json), or "none" (the directory is removed).
A live segment this far behind the newest audio is final; nearer ones stay provisional and the next window may replace them.
Seconds between two writes of live-checkpoint.json while recording; a daemon that dies mid-meeting recovers the meeting from the last one.
A microphone segment that is a filler and sits within this many milliseconds of a long remote segment is the speakers heard through the microphone, and is dropped.

The artifact policy `dettivo meetings delete` and the app use when none is named: transcript_only (the texts, segments and analysis go, the notes and the audio stay), transcript_and_audio (the takes go too, the facts and the notes stay) or all (the row and the directory go).
Run the pass by itself when the finalisation completes; off leaves it to `dettivo meetings diarize <id>`.
Initial average-linkage cosine cutoff, followed by low-support cluster reassignment. The final speaker count need not vary monotonically.

Learn who spoke once a meeting is finalised (docs/meetings.md): the system track (the whole microphone track of a room-audio meeting) goes through dettivo-engine-diarize and every remote segment gets a speaker.
The speaker count the clustering is told; 0 lets it decide.

The least share of a sentence's diarized speech the winner must hold (0 to 1); 0 labels every sentence a turn overlaps, and a higher value leaves a mixed sentence unlabelled rather than risk a wrong name.
The catalogue model set under <models>/diarize/ (`dettivo speech download --provider diarize --model diarization-en`).
A sentence no speaker turn overlaps takes the nearest turn within this many milliseconds; beyond it the line stays unlabelled.
Each sentence takes the speaker who holds most of it (docs/meetings.md). A pause between aligned words at least this long, in milliseconds, also ends a sentence where the speaker differs across it.
Keep microphone.wav (one per take) and system.wav under <data_dir>/meetings/<id>/ after the meeting; off removes them at stop.
Transcribe while the meeting records: windows of both tracks go through the engine and arrive as meeting.segment events (docs/meetings.md). Off runs the finalisation alone when the meeting stops.
Milliseconds two consecutive live windows share, so a word cut by one window is whole in the next.
Milliseconds of new audio that cut the next live window.
The longest live window sent to the engine, in milliseconds; a window grows towards it while the engine catches up.
RMS (0 to 1) a live window must reach to be sent to the engine; 70 % of it keeps a window going while the previous one was speech.
A catalogue file instead of the built-in one (mirrors, tests). Empty means the built-in catalogue.
Downloads that may run at once.
Re-hash models on disk that have no verified manifest when the daemon starts; a mismatch quarantines the file.

The bar widget and the panel the Omarchy plugin draws (docs/omarchy.md). The plugin reads this section through `dettivo config get` and writes it through `dettivo config set`; its folder carries no state of its own. waveform: the six-bar mark. dot: a single dot.
How many recent dictations the panel lists.
The glyph's bars follow the live level while recording.
The shortcut label beside Open Dettivo, in Hyprland's chord notation.
panel: the plugin hosts the recording pill and dettivo-osd steps aside. service: dettivo-osd keeps the pill. off: no pill on Omarchy.
The recording pill outside Omarchy (dettivo-osd; the Omarchy plugin hosts the same pill as a panel). Off: dettivo-osd exits with a notice.
How long the error state stays before the pill hides.
How long the inserted and copied states stay before the pill hides.
auto: a layer-shell overlay where the compositor offers one, else a frameless always-on-top window. layer_shell or window force one host.
Distance from the anchored edges, in pixels.
focused: the focused output on Hyprland, the primary elsewhere. Or an output name such as DP-3; an output that disappears falls back to primary.
full follows the desktop's reduced-motion setting; reduced holds the bars still and cuts between states.
top, bottom, top_left, top_right, bottom_left or bottom_right.
The bars follow the live microphone level while listening.
History and settings data. Empty means $XDG_DATA_HOME/dettivo.
Model files. Empty means <data_dir>/models.

Per-app presets keyed by the Wayland app id or X11 class ("prefix*" matches a family); style, post_processors and custom_preset may override the preset's defaults. Thunderbird is the shipped example; code editors, terminals and chat apps have built-in defaults a profile overrides.
The preset an app without a profile takes: email, code, chat, notes, generic.
The global style: asDictated (each preset picks its own), formal, casual, veryCasual.
Custom presets keyed by name: { base, style, transforms, custom_rules, post_processors, model }; an app profile names one in custom_preset.
Named custom rules, edited through `dettivo polish rules`; an enabled rule joins every Enhanced rewrite. Each is { id, name, enabled, content } with content up to 500 characters.
The deterministic Polish pass (docs/polish.md). Global transforms; the code preset never runs smartPunctuation.
QA mode: accept the QA rig's fake capture and insertion targets. DETTIVO_QA=1 turns it on without editing this file.
A loopback address only (127.0.0.1 or ::1); anything else fails validation.

The daemon hosts the loopback REST shim at start (docs/rest.md); off, and `dettivo rest serve` hosts it on demand. Every request needs the shared token (DETTIVO_IPC_TOKEN, the Secret Service item, or the 0600 token file).
The largest request body, in bytes (50 MiB); a longer one is answered 413.
The TCP port; 0 takes an ephemeral port, reported in system.capabilities.
The time one request may take end to end, in milliseconds.
The meeting model; empty means the dictation model.
Model id under <models>/<provider>/; a session freezes it at start.
The Parakeet model `dettivo speech selection set --provider parakeet` switches to when `model` is not a Parakeet model.
Speech provider: whisper or parakeet.

The chunked pipeline behind imports and re-runs (docs/history.md). Audio is cut into windows of this many seconds. Quiet edges are trimmed before recognition so automatic language detection starts near speech.
Drop the known filler hallucinations ("thanks for watching", ...) before the text is stored.
Seconds two consecutive chunks share; the merger reconciles them by timestamp.
Seconds before a chunk's nominal end inside which the cut moves to the quietest point, so a chunk rarely ends mid-word.
RMS (0 to 1) under which a chunk is silence: it never reaches the engine and adds no text.
The largest upload transfer.chunk accumulates, in bytes (1 GiB).
